summary: Frontend-only verification of Vanalume modal scroll-lock bug fix and copy updates (Home hero + Footer). All 20 assertions passed across desktop (1440x810) and mobile (390x844) viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: About.jsx: modal-open effect correctly stops Lenis and locks body overflow; modal inner container uses data-lenis-prevent + overscroll-contain — fix is sound.
Minor console warning across pages: framer-motion useScroll warns 'container has a non-static position' — cosmetic, does not affect functionality.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified. On desktop the bio fit without overflow so inner scrollTop stayed 0 (expected). On mobile 390x844, bio overflowed and inner scrollTop advanced to 71 while window.scrollY and lenis.scroll stayed unchanged — proving scroll lock works. Both X button and backdrop close work; page scrolling resumes after close. Home hero copy and Footer tagline match the required plural strings exactly. Nav to / and /about OK.
